sources_and_provenance: All six work-order inputs were rehashed and matched their issued SHA-256 values before use.
The current r3 word transcript supplies exact word IDs and timings; the current r3 timemap supplies the 24 fps output clock used by the r8 carrier.
SHOT-PLAN.json was used for scene and lane meaning only because its authored timing predates the r3 revisions.
The prior shorts_briefs.json was treated as historical prompting only; none of its unbound public copy or absent claims was adopted.
assumptions: A source cut may include the fractional-frame pre-roll or post-roll required to retain the complete first and last timed word.
The future vertical builder will choose the portrait reframe and caption treatment without changing these contiguous narration ranges.
Pinned-comment entries in shorts-map.json state intent only and do not authorize public copy or a hand-typed episode URL.
unresolved_questions: Portrait reframing, caption density, music, overlay design and final render order remain for the vertical source and build stages.
